title: Townspeople claim 1992 UFO crash recovered by Brookhaven National Lab
summary: Jesse Michels tells of Townspeople claim 1992 UFO crash recovered by Brookhaven National Lab, about 1992 at Brookhaven National Laboratory, Long Island, New York, and relays what a named person told them. As told, not a fact.
place_text: Brookhaven National Laboratory, Long Island, New York

tellings.quote: And um in '92 a lot of the town's people around uh Brook Haven said that there was a UFO crash that was actually collected by the facility there as well.
Now, um I really like the '9s Brook Haven crash. I think that's really fantast.
tellings.difference: Dates it only to the 1990s and points to sheriff testimony rather than to townspeople.

tellings.quote: I believe there's a crash, a UFO crash in 1992 where everybody in that town, South Haven, um basically saw the National Labs itself recover this craft, collect it and like take it into the the national labs.

tellings.link_reason: The same 1992 UFO crash that townspeople say Brookhaven National Lab recovered.

as_told.title: 1992 UFO crash recovered by Brookhaven National Lab
as_told.place_text: South Haven / Brookhaven National Laboratory, New York

plain: The podcast host Jesse Michels says that in 1992 many people living near Brookhaven National Laboratory, a government science lab on Long Island, New York, said a UFO crashed and the lab collected it. In other retellings he dates it only to the 1990s and points to a sheriff's account, or names the town as South Haven and says everybody there saw the lab take the craft inside. If true, it would mean a national lab recovered a crashed craft in front of local witnesses.
